name: google-play-store-scraper
title: Google Play App Metadata & Ratings Scraper
description: Look up factual public Google Play app metadata by package ID: developer, category, aggregate rating counts, installs, price, version, Android requirement, and official URL.

app-scraped.eventDescription: Charged for each validated Google Play app metadata record saved to the dataset.

review-scraped.eventDescription: Legacy inactive pricing event retained until the next permitted pricing update; this Actor version does not collect or charge for reviews.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
